## What's new in v2.0.44

A full audit of the theme, with every issue found fixed. Nothing here changes how the theme looks.

### Overview dashboard
- **Storage sizes were 1024× too small.** OpenWrt reports disk and tmp space in KB; the card treated those numbers as bytes, so a 49 MB overlay read "49 KB". Percentages and bars were already right.
- **The clock under Uptime was off by your time zone** (8 hours ahead in Perth, for example). It now shows the correct local time.
- **Every Wi-Fi network showed a red "down" dot.** OpenWrt reports up/down per radio rather than per network; networks now show green whenever they're actually running.
- **Clients no longer counts the router itself or its gateway** (your ISP's router, or the main router on an access point).

### Navigation
- **Ctrl/Cmd-click (and Shift-click) on sidebar items and page tabs opens a new tab again**, instead of navigating the current page.
- **Pages restored with the browser's Back button could come back faded out**, mostly on iPhone/Safari. Fixed.

### Smaller fixes
- The login page now picks up the new stylesheet right after an update, like every other page.
- Translated menu labels can no longer break the page's scripts if a translation contains an apostrophe.
- Build pipeline hardening: the OpenWrt SDK build step is pinned to a reviewed version and runs with read-only access.

### Upgrading
Run the install line below again (standalone), or install the new package, then reload the page.
